system: Lo2 feedback dispatch / queue worker boundary
requirements: The feedback processing outcome must distinguish a processed failure from an already-failed or non-processed record.
The worker must expose the durable feedback result without exposing raw error text.
A failed Lo2 feedback result must remain fail-closed and must not be represented as an unqualified successful feedback outcome.
source_location: DOC-C Lo2 durable feedback/runtime section, source extraction lines 20955-21090
DOC-C feedback loop / uncertainty propagation section, source extraction lines 22473-22583
proven_gap_before: The runtime worker log emitted status and error code but did not expose the processLo2FeedbackDispatch processed discriminator.
The exact-head runtime had a failed Lo2 feedback result whose processing state could not be distinguished from a previously persisted failure using the existing log.
change: Added processed=${lo2Feedback.processed} to the bounded [LO2_FEEDBACK] worker log.
Added a static contract assertion that the worker log contains the discriminator.
security_impact: Preserves fail-closed behavior and emits only the allow-listed error code plus boolean processing discriminator; no raw error text was added.
determinism_impact: No authoritative state or ordering behavior changed; only bounded diagnostic output changed.
